overview:
Jan Schakowsky's retirement leaves this deep-blue Chicago-area seat open, but the district's strong Democratic lean makes the party a heavy favorite to hold it. Democrat Daniel Biss has raised nearly $3 million and drawn substantial outside spending on both sides, while Republican John Elleson shows little reported fundraising activity.

Prediction markets price a Democratic win at roughly 97%, consistent with the district's partisan baseline. The main uncertainty is the open-seat dynamic itself, which adds some variance but is unlikely to overcome the structural advantage. The race remains Safe Democratic.
